mapper.sql: select id, no, machine_code, machine_name,machine_type, type, dimension_minimum, dimension_maximum, class_shift, quata,quota_ratio, open_machine_class1, open_machine_class2, open_machine_class3, operator_qty, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark from t_cx_machine_info
mapper.select: select distinct cxr.embryo_code||'$'||cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ left join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.Embryo_Version and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.id is null order by cxr.embryo_code||'$'||cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION

select distinct cxr.BEAD_CODE from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*胎圈排程结果表*/ left join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.BEAD_CODE = ci.TIRE_RING_CODE and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.id is null
